abstract: Maintains quayside draft hydrography, berth allocation logs, and conveyor transfer throughput ratings
system_message:
You are the Port maritime operations manager (PORT), responsible for maintaining quayside draft hydrography, berth allocation logs, and conveyor transfer throughput ratings, as well as tracking quayside crane inspection records across regional export facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Quayside crane inspection（CRANE）
information_points.content:
PORT-CRANE-9L7：According to the annual crane load certification audit for the Galati Riverfront Silo Terminal, the primary quayside portal gantry cranes have a certified quayside crane safe working load of 60 t under a dual-spreader configuration.
PORT-CRANE-XJG：At the Reni Danube Grain Logistics Hub, the annual crane load certification audit confirms a certified quayside crane safe working load of 45 t for the primary quayside portal gantry cranes under a dual-spreader configuration.
PORT-CRANE-42I：For the Braila Agri-Bulk Transshipment Pier, the annual crane load certification audit records a certified quayside crane safe working load of 75 t on the primary quayside portal gantry cranes under a dual-spreader configuration.

information_points.title: Maintains quayside draft hydrography, berth allocation logs, and conveyor transfer throughput ratings（BERTH）
information_points.content:
PORT-BERTH-U43：At the Braila Agri-Bulk Transshipment Pier, bathymetric surveys for the direct vessel berthing pocket indicate a quayside berthing depth of 14.2 m at chart datum, and commissioning reports confirm the primary dual-belt shiploader delivers a peak grain loading rate of 1,500 t/h.
PORT-BERTH-71L：At the Reni Danube Grain Logistics Hub, bathymetric charting for the direct vessel berthing pocket records a quayside berthing depth of 12.0 m at chart datum, while the primary quayside dual-belt shiploader achieves a peak grain loading rate of 1,800 t/h into cargo holds.
PORT-BERTH-PQY：For the Galati Riverfront Silo Terminal, the quayside bathymetric survey chart for the direct vessel berthing pocket along the grain pier confirms a quayside berthing depth of 15.0 m alongside the quay wall at chart datum, while the primary quayside dual-belt shiploader achieves a peak grain loading rate of 1,500 t/h at full conveyor speed.
